subject: biology

hotspots.label: Artery
hotspots.description: The thick-walled vessel carrying blood away from the heart.
hotspots.function: Carries blood away from the heart under pressure.

hotspots.label: Vein
hotspots.description: The vessel carrying blood back toward the heart.
hotspots.function: Carries blood back to the heart.

hotspots.label: Capillary
hotspots.description: The tiniest vessel where materials pass between blood and cells.
hotspots.function: Where oxygen, nutrients, and waste are exchanged.
hotspots.positionHint: The fine mesh between arteries and veins.

hotspots.label: One-way valve
hotspots.description: The flap in a vein that stops blood flowing backward.
hotspots.function: Keeps blood flowing toward the heart.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette beneath the model, no floor grid, no scene props. The organ floats large and centered, lit with soft neutral studio light (no rim glow, no bloom, no emissive anywhere). Clean stylized-specimen quality matching the reference organ specimens - smooth continuous topology, medical-illustration-meets-product-render, not photoreal, not cartoon. COLOR IS RESTRAINED: the organ reads as a warm-paper specimen with a faint informational cast per structure, never a saturated legend color. Strong saturated color is reserved entirely for the small flat-colored hotspot dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.6, single 2K shared texture atlas where possible, baked AO. No subsurface scattering, no specular sheen. Cross-sections are clean flat-capped museum cuts, never gory or torn tissue. No emissive channels anywhere.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a stylized study of the three blood vessel types shown as clean cutaway tubes side by side: a thick walled artery, a thinner walled vein with a one-way valve flap, and a fine network of capillaries with tiny exchange dots passing through the wall. Soft muted palette (artery warm red, vein soft blue, capillary pink), no glow, no gore. Named nodes: ArteryTube, VeinTube, VeinValve, CapillaryMesh, ExchangeDots. Budget 18-26k.
